Dear Sir/Madam,

In continuation of our earlier intimation dated 12 August 2026, this is to inform you that Mr. Sandeep Gokhale (DIN: 00693885), who has been appointed as an Additional Non-Executive Independent Director, with effect from 1 September 2026, to hold office for a term of 5 consecutive years, i.e. till 31 August 2031, has joined the Board of the Company today, i.e. 1 September 2026.

You are requested to take the same on your record.

Dear Sir/Madam,

Please find enclosed the Notice of Postal Ballot dated 12 August 2026.

You are requested to take the same on your record.
